name: D3DCompiler
notes: FXC (D3DCompile and D3DReflect) uses Redist/D3D/x64/d3dcompiler_47.dll (file version 10.0.22621.2428) of the pinned Windows SDK 10.0.22621.0. The d3dcompiler_47.dll in System32 differs per OS build and is not used (Docs/Design/ShaderSystem.ko.md section 8, item 2; UE also opens its bundled copy by full path).

The Windows SDK is an installer and is not republished. bootstrap verifies the SHA-256 in the installed SDK and copies it to the user store (<file SHA-256>/d3dcompiler_47.dll). If another SDK overwrites the same Redist path and the SHA changes, bootstrap fails and the manifest must be pinned again.

License: Windows SDK license terms, Distributable Code. Redist/D3D/x64/d3dcompiler_47.dll is on the SDK REDIST.TXT list (learn.microsoft.com/legal/windows-sdk/redist, updated 2024-10-21) and may be redistributed unmodified only with Classic Windows (desktop) applications, never with Universal Windows apps, under the license distribution requirements (measurement S10, Docs/Design/ShaderSystem.ko.md section 8, item 2). No files are committed to the repository, so there is no licenses entry. Runtime executables do not ship it (Release exclusion, section 9); developer tool packages may carry it as an application-local copy.
